data.name: Sarah
data.description:
Sarah is Caillou's next-door neighbor and one of his close friends. She first appeared in the episode "Caillou Goes Around the Block". Sarah is in first grade, and in one episode, Caillou went to school with her. She visited China in "Sarah Goes on a Vacation". She is of Chinese ethnicity, and celebrated Chinese New Year in "Chinese Day". She owns a cat and a dog. Her cat is Ollie; her dog is Murphy. She is the daughter of Luclan and Shang.

== Appearance ==
Sarah is 6 years old, hypothetically standing at 3'8'' and weighing 45 lb. She is a young Chinese-Canadian girl with short black hair, wearing a yellow button-front dress with red elbow-length sleeves, collar, and pockets, red socks, green and yellow sneakers.

== Personality ==
Sarah is a kind and good-natured friend to Caillou, and also a bit of a tomboy.

Sarah's best friend is Caillou, even though he is younger than her. She also serves as a mentor to Caillou. Sarah has even stated that he is the closest thing to a little brother for her. Sarah loves Caillou deeply. While she is very caring towards Caillou, she has gotten annoyed with him occasionally, most notably in "Caillou's Snowman" when she gets upset at Caillou constantly throwing snowballs at her and almost leaves to go home.

== Trivia ==
- Sarah is one of the few characters on the show to have visible parents, as most characters' parents are only mentioned or seen briefly.
- Her name is of Hebrew origin, meaning "princess" or "noblewoman".
- Sarah's character design, particularly her black hair and eye shape, reflects her Chinese ethnicity.
- Sarah's family appears to be one of the few recurring non-white families in the show.
- Sarah has a cousin who appeared in the episode where she invites Caillou to celebrate Chinese New Year.
- In "Caillou Misses Sarah," Caillou feels sad when Sarah goes on a two-week trip, highlighting their close friendship.
- She has shown an interest in activities like flying kites, as seen in "Sarah's Kite."
- Sarah's closest friends include Caillou (who is also her best friend), Leo, and Clementine.
- Sarah enjoys spending time with Caillou and celebrating Chinese New Year.
- Sarah gets annoyed when Caillou misbehaves or cries.
